name: ZCCM Investments Holdings Plc
summary: ZCCM Investments Holdings Plc operates as a diversified mining investment and operations company in Zambia and internationally. It operates through two segments: Investments, and Mining and Processing. The company explores mines, and processes minerals, including copper, gold, amethyst, manganese, limestone, coal, and phosphate. It also engages in the provision of environmental consultancy, analytical, surveying, and radiation safety services; engineering services; and electric power energy business.
